translations.literal: In the tenth year, Lushan was made Military Commissioner of Hedong and memorialized that Wen serve as Vice Commissioner of Hedong, concurrently overseeing commission farming colonies and acting as Surveillance and Investigation Commissioner within the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Lushan was made military commissioner of Hedong and memorialized that Wen serve as vice commissioner, concurrently overseeing commission farming colonies and acting as surveillance and investigation commissioner within the circuit.

sentences.zh: 其載，又加兼雁門太守，仍知安邊郡鑄錢事，賜紫金魚袋。

translations.literal: That same year he was further made Concurrent Prefect of Yanmen, still overseeing border-commandery coin casting, and granted the purple-gold fish tally.
translations.idiomatic: That same year he was further made concurrent prefect of Yanmen, still overseeing border-commandery coin casting, and granted the purple-gold fish tally.

sentences.zh: 及丁所生憂，祿山又奏起復為本官。

translations.literal: When he entered mourning for his biological mother, Lushan again memorialized for him to be recalled from mourning to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: When he entered mourning for his biological mother, Lushan again memorialized for him to be recalled from mourning to his original post.

sentences.zh: 尋復奏為魏郡太守、兼侍御史。

translations.literal: Soon after he was again memorialized as Prefect of Wei Commandery, concurrently Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was again memorialized as prefect of Wei Commandery, concurrently attending censor.

sentences.zh: 楊國忠入相，素與溫交通，追入為御史中丞，仍充京畿、關內采訪處置使。

translations.literal: When Yang Guozhong entered the chancellery, having long been connected with Wen, Wen was recalled as Vice Grand Censor, concurrently serving as Commissioner for Surveillance and Disposition of the Capital Region and Guannei.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Guozhong entered the chancellery, having long been connected with Wen, Wen was recalled as vice grand censor, concurrently serving as commissioner for surveillance and disposition of the capital region and Guannei.

sentences.zh: 溫於范陽辭，祿山令累路館驛作白䌷帳以候之，又令男慶緒出界送，攏馬出驛數十步。

translations.literal: When Wen took leave at Fanyang, Lushan ordered relay stations along the route to erect white silk pavilions to receive him, and had his son Qingxu escort him beyond the border, holding his horse for dozens of steps beyond the post station.
translations.idiomatic: When Wen took leave at Fanyang, Lushan ordered relay stations along the route to erect white silk pavilions to receive him, and had his son Qingxu escort him beyond the border, holding his horse for dozens of steps beyond the post station.

sentences.zh: 及至西京，朝廷動靜，輒報祿山，信宿而達。

translations.literal: Once he reached the western capital, he promptly reported every movement at court to Lushan, and news arrived within two days.
translations.idiomatic: Once he reached the western capital, he promptly reported every movement at court to Lushan, and news arrived within two days.

sentences.zh: 十三載正月，祿山入朝，拜左僕射，充閑廄使。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year, Lushan came to court, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and made Commissioner of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirteenth year, Lushan came to court, was appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and made Commissioner of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 因奏加溫武部侍郎、兼御史中丞，充閑廄、苑內、營田、五坊等副使。

translations.literal: He memorialized that Wen be made Vice Director of the Ministry of War, concurrently Vice Grand Censor, and Deputy Commissioner of the Imperial Stud, Palace Pastures, Military Colonies, and Five Corrals.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that Wen be made Vice Director of the Ministry of War, concurrently vice grand censor, and deputy commissioner of the Imperial Stud, palace pastures, military colonies, and Five Corrals.

sentences.zh: 時楊國忠與祿山嫌隙已成，溫轉厚於祿山，國忠又忌之。

translations.literal: At that time the rift between Yang Guozhong and Lushan was already formed; Wen turned even closer to Lushan, and Guozhong again resented him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the rift between Yang Guozhong and Lushan was already formed; Wen turned even closer to Lushan, and Guozhong resented him again.

sentences.zh: 其冬，河東太守韋陟入奏於華清宮，陟自謂失職，托於溫結歡於祿山，廣載河東土物饋於溫，又及權貴。

translations.literal: That winter, Hedong Prefect Wei Zhi came to report at Huaqing Palace; deeming himself out of favor, he relied on Wen to cultivate goodwill with Lushan, loaded many local products of Hedong as gifts for Wen, and also for the powerful.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, Hedong Prefect Wei Zhi came to report at Huaqing Palace; deeming himself out of favor, he relied on Wen to cultivate goodwill with Lushan, loaded many local products of Hedong as gifts for Wen, and also for the powerful.

sentences.zh: 國忠諷評事吳豸之使鄉人告之，召付中書門下，對法官鞫之，陟伏其狀，貶桂嶺尉，溫澧陽長史。

translations.literal: Guozhong prompted Reviewing Secretary Wu Zhizhi to have a townsman report it; they were summoned to the Secretariat-Chancellery for questioning before judges; Zhi confessed, was demoted to Commandant of Guiling, Wen to Chief Secretary of Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: Guozhong prompted reviewing secretary Wu Zhizhi to have a townsman report it; they were summoned to the Secretariat-Chancellery for questioning before judges; Zhi confessed, was demoted to Commandant of Guiling, and Wen to chief secretary of Liyang.

sentences.zh: 溫判官員錫新興尉。

translations.literal: Wen's aide Yuan Xi was made Commandant of Xinxing.
translations.idiomatic: Wen's aide Yuan Xi was made commandant of Xinxing.

sentences.zh: 明年，溫又坐贓七千匹及奪人口馬奸穢事發，貶端州高要尉。

translations.literal: The following year Wen again fell afoul of the law over seven thousand bolts of silk in graft and seizing people, horses, and debauchery; he was demoted to Commandant of Gaoyao in Duan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Wen again fell afoul of the law over seven thousand bolts of silk in graft and seizing people, horses, and debauchery; he was demoted to commandant of Gaoyao in Duan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 溫至嶺外，遷延不進，依於張博濟，止於始安郡。

translations.literal: Wen reached beyond the Lingnan passes but delayed and did not proceed; he took refuge with Zhang Boji and stopped in Shian Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Wen reached beyond the Lingnan passes but delayed and did not proceed; he took refuge with Zhang Boji and stopped in Shian Commandery.

sentences.zh: 八月，遣大理司直蔣沇鞫之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Judicial Review Secretariat Straight Officer Jiang Yan was sent to investigate him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, judicial review secretariat straight officer Jiang Yan was sent to investigate him.

sentences.zh: 溫死於獄中，博濟及始安太守羅希奭死於州門。

translations.literal: Wen died in prison; Boji and Shian Prefect Luo Xiyi died at the prefectural gate.
translations.idiomatic: Wen died in prison; Boji and Shian Prefect Luo Xiyi died at the prefectural gate.

sentences.zh: 初，溫之貶斥，玄宗在華清宮，謂朝臣曰：「吉溫是酷吏子侄，朕被人誑惑，用之至此。

translations.literal: Previously, when Wen was demoted, Emperor Xuanzong was at Huaqing Palace and told the court: "Ji Wen is the nephew of a cruel official; I was deceived into using him to this point.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, when Wen was demoted, Emperor Xuanzong was at Huaqing Palace and told the court: "Ji Wen is the nephew of a cruel official; I was deceived into using him to this point.

sentences.zh: 屢勸朕起刑獄以作威福，朕不受其言。

translations.literal: He repeatedly urged me to launch criminal prosecutions to wield power and favor; I did not accept his counsel.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly urged me to launch criminal prosecutions to wield power and favor; I did not accept his counsel.

sentences.zh: 今去矣，卿等皆可安枕也！」

translations.literal: Now he is gone—you may all rest easy!"
translations.idiomatic: Now he is gone—you may all rest easy!"

sentences.zh: 初，開元九年，有王鈞為洛陽尉。

translations.literal: Previously, in the ninth year of Kaiyuan, there was Wang Jun who served as Luoyang Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in the ninth year of Kaiyuan, there was Wang Jun who served as Luoyang commandant.

sentences.zh: 十八年，有嚴安之為河南丞。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, there was Yan Anzhi who served as Assistant Intendant of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, there was Yan Anzhi who served as assistant intendant of Henan.

sentences.zh: 皆性毒虐，笞罰人畏其不死，皆杖訖不放起，須其腫憤，徐乃重杖之，懊血流地，苦楚欲死，鈞與安之始眉目喜暢，故人吏懾懼。

translations.literal: Both were cruel by nature in punishment; fearing victims would not die, after beating they would not let them rise, waited until swelling and rage set in, then slowly beat them again—blood streamed from split flesh, anguish unto death—only then did Jun and Anzhi show satisfied expression; officials and clerks trembled in fear.
translations.idiomatic: Both were cruel by nature in punishment; fearing victims would not die, after beating they would not let them rise, waited until swelling and rage set in, then slowly beat them again—blood streamed from split flesh, anguish unto death—only then did Jun and Anzhi show satisfied expression; officials and clerks trembled in fear.

sentences.zh: 溫則售身權貴，噬螫衣冠，來頗異耳。

translations.literal: Wen sold himself to the powerful and bit at the gentry—a rather different case.
translations.idiomatic: Wen sold himself to the powerful and preyed on the gentry—a rather different case.

sentences.zh: 溫九月死始興。

translations.literal: Wen died in the ninth month at Shixing.
translations.idiomatic: Wen died in the ninth month at Shixing.

sentences.zh: 十一月，祿山起兵作亂，人謂與溫報仇耳。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Lushan raised troops in rebellion; people said it was to avenge Wen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Lushan raised troops in rebellion; people said it was to avenge Wen.

sentences.zh: 祿山入洛陽城，即偽位。

translations.literal: Lushan entered Luoyang and immediately declared himself emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Lushan entered Luoyang and immediately declared himself emperor.

sentences.zh: 玄宗幸蜀後，祿山求得溫一子，才六七歲，授河南府參軍，給與財帛。

translations.literal: After Emperor Xuanzong fled to Shu, Lushan found one of Wen's sons, only six or seven years old, appointed him Adjutant of Henan Prefecture, and provided goods and silk.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Xuanzong fled to Shu, Lushan found one of Wen's sons, only six or seven years old, appointed him adjutant of Henan Prefecture, and provided goods and silk.

sentences.zh: 初，溫之按楊慎矜，侍御史盧鉉同其事。

translations.literal: Previously, when Wen investigated Yang Shenjin, Attending Censor Lu Xuan participated in the same affair.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, when Wen investigated Yang Shenjin, attending censor Lu Xuan participated in the same affair.

sentences.zh: 鉉初為御史，作韋堅判官。

translations.literal: Xuan had first served as censor as judge in Wei Jian's case.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan had first served as censor as judge in Wei Jian's case.

sentences.zh: 及堅為李林甫所嫉，鉉以堅款曲發於林甫，冀售其身。

translations.literal: When Jian came to be envied by Li Linfu, Xuan reported Jian's confidential affairs to Linfu, hoping to sell himself for favor.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei Jian came to be envied by Li Linfu, Xuan reported Jian's confidential affairs to Linfu, hoping to win favor by betraying him.

sentences.zh: 及按慎矜，鉉先與張瑄同臺，情旨素厚，貴取媚於權臣，誣瑄與楊慎矜共解圖讖。

translations.literal: When investigating Shenjin, Xuan had previously served on the same censorate board as Zhang Xuan and they had been close; to please powerful ministers he falsely accused Xuan of jointly interpreting prophecy charts with Yang Shenjin.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yang Shenjin case was investigated, Xuan—who had long served alongside Zhang Xuan on the censorate and been close to him—curried favor with powerful ministers by falsely accusing Xuan of jointly interpreting prophecy charts with Yang Shenjin.

sentences.zh: 持之，為驢駒板橛以成其獄。

translations.literal: He pressed the case, using donkey-foal-and-board-stake evidence to complete the prison case.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed the case, fabricating trivial evidence as solid proof to complete the prison case.

sentences.zh: 又為王鉷閑廄判官，鉷緣邢縡事朝堂被推，鉉證云：「大夫將白帖索廄馬五百匹以助逆，我不與之。」

translations.literal: He also served as judge for Wang Hong's spare-stable office. When Hong was impeached at court over Xing Zuo's affair, Xuan testified: "The Grandee intended to send a white note requesting five hundred stable horses to aid rebellion—I refused him."
translations.idiomatic: He also served as judge in Wang Hong's spare-stable office. When Hong was impeached at court over Xing Zuo's affair, Xuan testified: "The Grandee intended to send a white note requesting five hundred stable horses to aid rebellion—I refused him."

sentences.zh: 鉷死在晷刻，鉉忍誣之，眾咸怒恨焉。

translations.literal: Hong died within the day; Xuan ruthlessly bore false witness against him, and all were filled with anger and resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Hong died within the day, yet Xuan ruthlessly bore false witness against him; all were filled with anger and resentment.

sentences.zh: 及被貶為廬江長史，在郡忽見瑄為祟，乃云：「端公何得來乞命？

translations.literal: When demoted to Chief Clerk of Lujiang, in the commandery he suddenly saw Xuan's ghost haunting him and said: "Sir, how can you come begging for your life?
translations.idiomatic: When he was demoted to chief clerk of Lujiang, he suddenly saw Zhang Xuan's ghost in the commandery and cried: "Sir, how can you come begging for your life?

sentences.zh: 不自由。」

translations.literal: I am not free to do so."
translations.idiomatic: I am not free to do so."

sentences.zh: 鉉須臾而卒。

translations.literal: Xuan died within moments.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan died within moments.

sentences.zh: 羅希奭羅希奭，本杭州人也，近家洛陽，鴻臚少卿張博濟堂外甥。

translations.literal: Luo Xixi—Luo Xixi was originally from Hangzhou but had lately made his home in Luoyang; he was the maternal nephew of Vice Minister of Ceremonials Zhang Boji.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Xixi was originally from Hangzhou but had lately settled near Luoyang; he was the maternal nephew of Vice Minister of Ceremonials Zhang Boji.

sentences.zh: 為吏持法深刻。

translations.literal: As an official he enforced the law with harsh severity.
translations.idiomatic: As an official he enforced the law with pitiless severity.

sentences.zh: 天寶初，右相李林甫引與吉溫持獄，又與希奭姻婭，自御史臺主簿再遷殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: Early in the Tianbao era, Right Chancellor Li Linfu recruited him with Ji Wen to handle prison cases; he was also related to Xixi by marriage, and rose from Chief Clerk of the Censorate to Attending Palace Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianbao era, Right Chancellor Li Linfu recruited him with Ji Wen to handle prison cases. Related to Xixi by marriage, he rose from chief clerk of the Censorate to attending palace censor.

sentences.zh: 自韋堅、皇甫惟明、李適之、柳勣、裴敦復、李邕、鄔元昌、楊慎矜、趙奉璋下獄事，皆與溫鍛煉，故時稱「羅鉗吉網」，惡其深刻也。

translations.literal: From the imprisonments of Wei Jian, Huangfu Weiming, Li Shizhi, Liu Ji, Pei Dunfu, Li Yong, Wu Yuanchang, Yang Shenjin, and Zhao Fengzhang—he forged cases with Wen throughout, so contemporaries called them "Luo's pincers and Ji's net," loathing their severity.
translations.idiomatic: In the cases that sent Wei Jian, Huangfu Weiming, Li Shizhi, Liu Ji, Pei Dunfu, Li Yong, Wu Yuanchang, Yang Shenjin, and Zhao Fengzhang to prison, he forged evidence with Wen throughout. Contemporaries called them "Luo's pincers and Ji's net," loathing their pitiless severity.

sentences.zh: 八載，除刑部員外，轉郎中。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice, then promoted to Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed vice director of the Ministry of Justice, then promoted to director.

sentences.zh: 十一載，李林甫卒，出為中部、始安二太守，仍充當管經略使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, after Li Linfu died, he was sent out as Prefect of both Zhongbu and Shian, concurrently serving as Military Commissioner of the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, after Li Linfu died, he was sent out as prefect of Zhongbu and Shian, concurrently serving as military commissioner of the circuit.

sentences.zh: 十四載，以張博濟、吉溫，韋陟、韋誡奢、李從一、員錫等流貶，皆於始安，希奭或令假攝。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, because Zhang Boji, Ji Wen, Wei Zhi, Wei Jieshe, Li Congyi, Yuan Xi, and others were banished—all to Shian—Xixi sometimes had them act as temporary substitutes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Zhang Boji, Ji Wen, Wei Zhi, Wei Jieshe, Li Congyi, Yuan Xi, and others were banished—all to Shian—where Xixi sometimes had them serve as temporary substitutes.

sentences.zh: 右相楊國忠奏遣司直蔣沇往按之，復令張光奇替為始安太守。

translations.literal: Right Chancellor Yang Guozhong memorialized to send Judicial Commissioner Jiang Yan to investigate, and had Zhang Guangqi replace him as Prefect of Shian.
translations.idiomatic: Right Chancellor Yang Guozhong memorialized to send judicial commissioner Jiang Yan to investigate, and had Zhang Guangqi replace him as prefect of Shian.

sentences.zh: 仍降敕曰：

translations.literal: An edict was further issued, stating:
translations.idiomatic: An edict was further issued, stating:

sentences.zh: 前始安郡太守、充當管經略使羅希奭，幸此資序，叨居牧守。

translations.literal: The former Prefect of Shian Commandery and Military Commissioner of the circuit, Luo Xixi, by fortune of seniority had presumptuously held a governorship.
translations.idiomatic: The former prefect of Shian Commandery and military commissioner of the circuit, Luo Xixi, by seniority alone had presumptuously held a governorship.

sentences.zh: 地列要荒，人多竄殛，尤加委任，冀絕奸訛。

translations.literal: The region was strategically remote and its people mostly fugitives under sentence of death; he was especially entrusted, in hope that treachery and wrongdoing would be stamped out.
translations.idiomatic: The region was strategically remote and its people mostly fugitives under sentence of death; he was especially entrusted in the hope that treachery and wrongdoing would be stamped out.

sentences.zh: 翻乃嘯結逋逃，群聚不逞，應是流貶，公然安置。

translations.literal: Instead he rallied escaped convicts and gathered the lawless, openly settling every person who should have been banished.
translations.idiomatic: Instead he rallied escaped convicts and gathered the lawless, openly settling every person who should have been banished.

sentences.zh: 或差攝郡縣，割剝黎氓；

translations.literal: Some he dispatched to act as substitutes in prefectures and counties, stripping and exploiting the common people;
translations.idiomatic: Some he dispatched to act as substitutes in prefectures and counties, stripping and exploiting the common people;

sentences.zh: 或輟借館宇，侵擾人吏。

translations.literal: others he lent official quarters, harassing clerks and attendants.
translations.idiomatic: others he lent official quarters, harassing clerks and attendants.

sentences.zh: 不唯輕侮典憲，實亦隳壞紀綱。

translations.literal: He not only treated the statutes with contempt but truly ruined discipline and law.
translations.idiomatic: He not only treated the statutes with contempt but truly ruined discipline and law.

sentences.zh: 擢發數愆，豈多其罪，可貶海東郡海康尉、員外置。

translations.literal: Counting his offenses hair by hair would not exhaust them; his crimes can hardly be called few. He is demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Haikang in Haidong Commandery, an extra-staff appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Counting his offenses hair by hair would not exhaust them—his crimes can hardly be called few. He is demoted to assistant magistrate of Haikang in Haidong Commandery, an extra-staff appointment.

sentences.zh: 張博濟往托回邪，跡惟憑恃，嘗自抵犯，又坐親姻，前後貶官，歲月頗久，逗留不赴，情狀難容。

translations.literal: Zhang Boji has long relied on crooked paths, his conduct resting solely on patronage; he has repeatedly offended on his own account and also through kinship by marriage. Banished repeatedly over many years, he has lingered without reporting—conduct hard to tolerate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Boji has long relied on crooked paths, his conduct resting solely on patronage; he has repeatedly offended on his own account and also through kinship by marriage. Banished repeatedly over many years, he has lingered without reporting—conduct hard to tolerate.

sentences.zh: 及命按舉，仍更潛匿，亡命逭刑，莫斯為甚。

translations.literal: When ordered to be investigated, he again hid in secret, fleeing justice to evade punishment—nothing more grave than this.
translations.idiomatic: When ordered to be investigated, he again hid in secret, fleeing justice to evade punishment—nothing more grave than this.

sentences.zh: 並當切害，合峻常刑，宜於所在各決重杖六十。

translations.literal: All are to be severely punished; standard law demands stern penalty. Each is to receive sixty blows of the heavy staff where he is found.
translations.idiomatic: All are to be severely punished; standard law demands stern penalty. Each is to receive sixty blows of the heavy staff where he is found.

sentences.zh: 使夫為政之士，克守章程；

translations.literal: Let those who hold office strictly keep the regulations;
translations.idiomatic: Let those who hold office strictly keep the regulations;

sentences.zh: 負罪之人，期於悛革。

translations.literal: let those who bear guilt look to reform themselves.
translations.idiomatic: let those who bear guilt look to reform themselves.

sentences.zh: 凡厥在位，宜各悉心。

translations.literal: All who hold position should each devote their full hearts to this.
translations.idiomatic: All who hold position should each devote their full hearts to this.

sentences.zh: 時員錫、李從一、韋誡奢、吉承恩並決杖，遣司直宇文審往監之。

translations.literal: At that time Yuan Xi, Li Congyi, Wei Jieshe, and Ji Chengen were all sentenced to beating with the heavy staff, and Judicial Commissioner Yu Wenshen was sent to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Yuan Xi, Li Congyi, Wei Jieshe, and Ji Chengen were all sentenced to beating with the heavy staff, and judicial commissioner Yu Wenshen was sent to supervise.

sentences.zh: 毛若虛毛若虛，絳州太平人也。

translations.literal: Mao Ruoxu—Mao Ruoxu was a native of Taiping in Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Ruoxu was a native of Taiping in Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 眉毛覆於眼，其性殘忍。

translations.literal: His eyebrows covered his eyes, and his nature was cruel.
translations.idiomatic: His eyebrows covered his eyes, and his nature was cruel.

sentences.zh: 初為蜀川縣尉，使司以推勾見任。

translations.literal: He first served as Magistrate of Shuchuan County; the dispatch office recognized his talent for investigation and retained him.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as magistrate of Shuchuan County; the dispatch office recognized his talent for investigation and retained him.

sentences.zh: 天寶末，為武功丞，年已六十餘矣。

translations.literal: At the end of Tianbao he was Assistant Magistrate of Wugong, already more than sixty years old.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Tianbao he was assistant magistrate of Wugong, already more than sixty years old.

sentences.zh: 肅宗收兩京，除監察御史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Suzong recovered the two capitals, he was appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Suzong recovered the two capitals, he was appointed investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 審國用不足，上策徵剝財貨。

translations.literal: Examining the state of national finances, he submitted plans to levy and extort goods and wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing that state revenues were insufficient, he submitted plans to levy and extort goods and wealth.

sentences.zh: 有潤於公者，日有進奉，漸見任用稱旨。

translations.literal: Where there was profit for the state treasury, he made daily tribute offerings and gradually came to be employed in ways that pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Where there was profit for the public treasury, he made daily tribute offerings and gradually came to be employed in ways that pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 每推一人，未鞫，即先收其家資，以定贓數。

translations.literal: Each time he investigated someone, before interrogation he would first seize the household's assets to fix the embezzlement figure.
translations.idiomatic: Each time he investigated someone, before interrogation he would first seize the household's assets to fix the embezzlement figure.

sentences.zh: 不滿望，即攤徵鄉里近親。

translations.literal: If the amount did not meet expectations, he would spread the levy among neighbors and close kin in the village.
translations.idiomatic: If the amount did not meet expectations, he would spread the levy among neighbors and close kin in the village.

sentences.zh: 峻其威權，人皆懼死，輸納不差晷刻，

translations.literal: He made his authority fiercely intimidating; all feared death and paid within the hour.
translations.idiomatic: He made his authority fiercely intimidating; all feared death and paid within the hour.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔府七坊押官先行剽劫，州縣不能制，因有劫殺事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianyuan, the Qifang yaguan of Fengxiang Prefecture first took to plundering and robbery; the prefecture and counties could not control them, and thus there arose robbery and killing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianyuan, the Qifang yaguan of Fengxiang Prefecture first took to plundering and robbery; the prefecture and counties could not control them, and thus there arose robbery and killing.

sentences.zh: 縣尉謝夷甫因眾怒，遂搒殺之。

translations.literal: The county magistrate Xie Yifu, acting on public outrage, beat the man to death.
translations.idiomatic: The county magistrate Xie Yifu, acting on public outrage, beat the man to death.

sentences.zh: 其妻訴於李輔國，輔國奏請御史孫瑩鞫之。

translations.literal: The man's wife appealed to Li Fuguo; Fuguo memorialized requesting Investigator Sun Ying to try the case.
translations.idiomatic: The man's wife appealed to Li Fuguo; Fuguo memorialized requesting investigator Sun Ying to try the case.

sentences.zh: 瑩不能正其事。

translations.literal: Ying could not set the matter right.
translations.idiomatic: Ying could not set the matter right.

sentences.zh: 又令中丞崔伯陽三司使雜訊之，又不證成其罪。

translations.literal: He was again ordered, with Vice Censor-in-Chief Cui Boyang as Three Offices Commissioner, to conduct mixed interrogation, but still could not establish guilt.
translations.idiomatic: The court again ordered Vice Censor-in-Chief Cui Boyang, as Three Offices commissioner, to conduct mixed interrogation, but still could not establish guilt.

sentences.zh: 因令若虛推之，遂歸罪於夷甫。

translations.literal: Ruoxu was then ordered to investigate; he shifted blame onto Yifu.
translations.idiomatic: Ruoxu was then ordered to investigate; he shifted blame onto Yifu.

sentences.zh: 伯陽與之言，若虛頗不遜。

translations.literal: When Boyang spoke with him, Ruoxu was quite insolent.
translations.idiomatic: When Boyang spoke with him, Ruoxu was quite insolent.

sentences.zh: 伯陽數讓之，若虛馳謁告急。

translations.literal: Boyang repeatedly reproached him; Ruoxu raced to audience to report an emergency.
translations.idiomatic: Boyang repeatedly reproached him; Ruoxu raced to audience to report an emergency.

sentences.zh: 肅宗曰：「卿且出。」

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong said: "Leave for now."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Suzong said: "Leave for now."

sentences.zh: 對曰：「臣出即死矣。」

translations.literal: He replied: "If I leave, I shall die at once."
translations.idiomatic: He replied: "If I leave, I shall die at once."

sentences.zh: 肅宗潛留若虛簾內，召伯陽至，伯陽頗短若虛。

translations.literal: Suzong secretly kept Ruoxu behind the curtain, summoned Boyang, and Boyang spoke ill of Ruoxu.
translations.idiomatic: Suzong secretly kept Ruoxu behind the curtain, summoned Boyang, and Boyang spoke ill of Ruoxu.

sentences.zh: 上怒，叱出之。

translations.literal: The emperor was angered and shouted him out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angered and shouted him out.

sentences.zh: 因流貶伯陽同推官十餘人，皆於嶺外遠惡處。

translations.literal: Accordingly Boyang and more than ten fellow investigators were banished to remote, harsh places beyond the Ling Range.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly Boyang and more than ten fellow investigators were banished to remote, harsh places beyond the Ling Range.

sentences.zh: 宰相李峴以左右於瑩等，亦被貶斥。

translations.literal: Chancellor Li Xian, for siding with Ying and the others, was also demoted and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Li Xian, for siding with Ying and the others, was also demoted and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 於是若虛威震朝列，公卿懾懼矣！

translations.literal: Thereupon Ruoxu's power shook the court ranks, and dukes and ministers trembled in fear!
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Ruoxu's power shook the court ranks, and dukes and ministers trembled in fear!

sentences.zh: 尋擢為御史中丞，

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 貶賓化尉而死。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shangyuan, he was demoted to Assistant Magistrate of Binhua and died there.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shangyuan, he was demoted to assistant magistrate of Binhua and died there.

sentences.zh: 敬羽敬羽，寶鼎人也。

translations.literal: Jing Yu—Jing Yu was a native of Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Yu was a native of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 父昭道，開元初為監察御史。

translations.literal: His father Zhaodao served as Investigating Censor early in Kaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhaodao served as investigating censor early in Kaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 羽貌寢而性便僻，善候人意旨。

translations.literal: Yu was homely in appearance but slippery in character, skilled at reading others' intent.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was homely in appearance but slippery in character, skilled at reading others' intent.

sentences.zh: 天寶九載，為康成縣尉。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tianbao he was Magistrate of Kangsheng County.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tianbao he was magistrate of Kangsheng County.

sentences.zh: 安思順為朔方節度使，引在幕下。

translations.literal: When An Sishun was Military Commissioner of Shuofang, he brought Yu onto his staff.
translations.idiomatic: When An Sishun was military commissioner of Shuofang, he brought Yu onto his staff.

sentences.zh: 及肅宗於靈武即大位，羽尋擢為監察御史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Suzong took the throne at Lingwu, Yu was soon promoted to Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Suzong took the throne at Lingwu, Yu was soon promoted to investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 以苛刻徵剝求進。

translations.literal: He used harsh extortion and levies to seek advancement.
translations.idiomatic: He used harsh extortion and levies to seek advancement.

sentences.zh: 及收兩京後，轉見委任。

translations.literal: After the two capitals were recovered, he came to be increasingly entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: After the two capitals were recovered, he came to be increasingly entrusted.

sentences.zh: 作大枷，有鹴尾榆，著即悶絕。

translations.literal: He made great cangues with serrated elm at the tail end; once fitted, the prisoner would suffocate.
translations.idiomatic: He made great cangues with serrated elm at the tail end; once fitted, the prisoner would suffocate.

sentences.zh: 又臥囚於地，以門關輾其腹，號為「肉餺飥」。

translations.literal: He also made prisoners lie on the ground and rolled a door bar across their bellies—a technique called "meat wontons."
translations.idiomatic: He also made prisoners lie on the ground and rolled a door bar across their bellies—a technique called "meat wontons."

sentences.zh: 掘地為坑，實以棘刺，以敗席覆上，領囚臨坑訊之，必墜其中，萬刺攢之。

translations.literal: He dug pits in the ground, filled them with thorns, covered them with tattered mats, led prisoners to the edge for questioning—they inevitably fell in and were pierced by ten thousand spikes.
translations.idiomatic: He dug pits in the ground, filled them with thorns, covered them with tattered mats, and led prisoners to the edge for questioning—they inevitably fell in and were pierced by ten thousand spikes.

sentences.zh: 又捕逐錢貨，不減毛若虛。

translations.literal: He also hunted down money and goods, no less ruthlessly than Mao Ruoxu.
translations.idiomatic: He also hunted down money and goods, no less ruthlessly than Mao Ruoxu.

sentences.zh: 上元中，擢為御史中丞。

translations.literal: During Shangyuan he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: During Shangyuan he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 太子少傅、宗正卿、鄭國公李遵，為宗子通事舍人李若冰告其贓私，詔羽按之。

translations.literal: The Heir Apparent's Junior Tutor, Director of the Imperial Clan, Duke of Zheng Li Zun was denounced for embezzlement by Imperial Clan Attendant Li Ruobing; Yu was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The Heir Apparent's junior tutor, director of the Imperial Clan, Duke of Zheng Li Zun was denounced for embezzlement by imperial clan attendant Li Ruobing; Yu was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 羽延遵，各危坐於小床。

translations.literal: Yu invited Zun to sit, each perched uneasily on a small stool.
translations.idiomatic: Yu invited Zun to sit, each perched uneasily on a small stool.

sentences.zh: 羽小瘦，遵豐碩，頃間問即倒，請垂足。

translations.literal: Yu was small and lean; Zun was stout and full-bodied. After a moment's questioning he collapsed and asked to let his feet hang down.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was small and lean; Zun was stout and full-bodied. After a moment's questioning he collapsed and asked to let his feet hang down.

sentences.zh: 羽曰：「尚書下獄是囚，羽禮延坐，何得慢耶！」

translations.literal: Yu said: "Minister, you are a prisoner under arrest; Yu has courteously invited you to sit—how dare you be insolent!"
translations.idiomatic: Yu said: "Minister, you are a prisoner under arrest; Yu has courteously invited you to sit—how dare you be insolent!"

sentences.zh: 遵絕倒者數四。

translations.literal: Zun fainted dead away four times.
translations.idiomatic: Zun fainted dead away four times.

sentences.zh: 請問，羽徐應之，授紙筆，書贓數千貫，奏之。

translations.literal: When questioned, Yu answered slowly, handed him brush and paper, had him write out embezzlement of several thousand strings of cash, and memorialized it.
translations.idiomatic: When questioned, Yu answered slowly, handed him brush and paper, had him write out embezzlement of several thousand strings of cash, and memorialized it.

sentences.zh: 肅宗以勛舊舍之，但停宗正卿。

translations.literal: Emperor Suzong pardoned him for his meritorious service but stripped him of the directorship of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Suzong pardoned him for his meritorious service but stripped him of the directorship of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 及嗣薛王珍潛謀不軌，詔羽鞫之。

translations.literal: When Prince Ji of Xue, Li Zhen, secretly plotted treason, Yu was ordered to try him.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Ji of Xue, Li Zhen, secretly plotted treason, Yu was ordered to try him.

sentences.zh: 羽召支黨羅於廷，索鹴尾榆枷之，布栲訊之具以繞之，信宿成獄。

translations.literal: Yu summoned his partisans and assembled them in the court, fitted them with serrated-elm cangues, surrounded them with torture implements, and within two nights the case was complete.
translations.idiomatic: Yu summoned his partisans and assembled them in the court, fitted them with serrated-elm cangues, surrounded them with torture implements, and within two nights the case was complete.

sentences.zh: 珍坐死，右衛將軍竇如玢、試都水使者崔昌等九人並斬，太子洗馬趙非熊、陳王府長史陳閎、楚州司馬張昴、左武衛兵曹參軍焦自榮，前鳳翔府郿縣主簿李、廣文館進士張夐等六人決殺，駙馬都尉薛履謙賜自盡，左散騎常侍張鎬貶辰州司戶。

translations.literal: Zhen was sentenced to death. Right Guard General Dou Rubin, Provisional Commissioner of Waterways Cui Chang, and nine others were all beheaded. Heir Apparent's Reader Zhao Feixiong, Prince of Chen's Chief Administrator Chen Hong, Chu Prefecture Military Aide Zhang Ang, Left Martial Guard Army Records Officer Jiao Zirong, former Meixian Chief Clerk of Fengxiang Li, Imperial Academy Graduate Zhang Xiong, and six others were executed by beating. Chief Commandant of Horse Marriages Xue Lüqian was granted permission to take his own life. Left Regular Attendant Zhang Hao was demoted to Registrar of Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was sentenced to death. Right Guard General Dou Rubin, provisional commissioner of waterways Cui Chang, and nine others were all beheaded. Heir Apparent's reader Zhao Feixiong, Prince of Chen's chief administrator Chen Hong, Chu Prefecture military aide Zhang Ang, Left Martial Guard army records officer Jiao Zirong, former Meixian chief clerk of Fengxiang Li, Imperial Academy graduate Zhang Xiong, and six others were executed by beating. Chief commandant of horse marriages Xue Lüqian was granted permission to take his own life. Left regular attendant Zhang Hao was demoted to registrar of Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 胡人康謙善賈，資產億萬計。

translations.literal: The foreigner Kang Qian was skilled in trade; his assets numbered in the tens of millions.
translations.idiomatic: The foreigner Kang Qian was skilled in trade; his assets numbered in the tens of millions.

sentences.zh: 楊國忠為相，授安南都護。

translations.literal: When Yang Guozhong became chancellor, he was appointed Protector-General of Annan.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Guozhong became chancellor, he was appointed protector-general of Annan.

sentences.zh: 至德中，為試鴻臚卿，專知山南東路。

translations.literal: During Zhide he served as Provisional Minister of Ceremonials, specifically overseeing the Eastern Circuit of Shannan.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhide he served as provisional minister of ceremonials, specifically overseeing the Eastern Circuit of Shannan.

sentences.zh: 驛人嫉之，告其陰通史朝義。

translations.literal: Post-station workers envied him and reported that he had secretly communicated with Shi Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Post-station workers envied him and reported that he had secretly communicated with Shi Chaoyi.

sentences.zh: 謙髭鬚長三尺過帶，按之兩宿，鬢髮皆禿，膝踝亦栲碎，視之者以為鬼物，非人類也。

translations.literal: Qian's beard was three feet long, hanging past his belt. After two nights of interrogation his sideburns and hair were all gone, his knees and ankles crushed by torture; those who saw him thought him a ghost, not human.
translations.idiomatic: Qian's beard was three feet long, hanging past his belt. After two nights of interrogation his sideburns and hair were all gone, his knees and ankles crushed by torture; those who saw him thought him a ghost, not human.

sentences.zh: 乞舍其生，以後送狀奏殺之，沒其資產。

translations.literal: He begged to spare his life, but in the end a memorial was submitted requesting his execution; his assets were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: He begged to spare his life, but in the end a memorial was submitted requesting his execution; his assets were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 羽與毛若虛在臺五六年間，臺中囚繫不絕。

translations.literal: During the five or six years Yu and Mao Ruoxu served at the Censorate, prisoners in the office were never absent.
translations.idiomatic: During the five or six years Yu and Mao Ruoxu served at the Censorate, prisoners in the office were never absent.

sentences.zh: 又有裴升、畢曜同為御史，皆酷毒。

translations.literal: There were also Pei Sheng and Bi Yao, fellow censors, all cruelly vicious.
translations.idiomatic: There were also Pei Sheng and Bi Yao, fellow censors, all cruelly vicious.

sentences.zh: 人之陷刑，當時有毛、敬、裴、畢之稱。

translations.literal: When men fell into punishment, the age spoke of Mao, Jing, Pei, and Bi.
translations.idiomatic: When men fell into punishment, the age spoke of Mao, Jing, Pei, and Bi.

sentences.zh: 裴、畢尋又流黔中。

translations.literal: Pei and Bi were soon banished to Qianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Pei and Bi were soon banished to Qianzhong.

sentences.zh: 羽，貶為道州刺史。

translations.literal: Yu was demoted to Prefect of Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was demoted to prefect of Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 尋有詔殺之，羽聞之，衣兇服南奔溪洞，為吏所擒。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered his execution; on hearing it Yu dressed in mourning garb and fled south into mountain gorges, but was captured by officials.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict ordered his execution; on hearing it Yu dressed in garments of ill omen and fled south into mountain gorges, but was captured by officials.

sentences.zh: 臨刑，袖中執州縣官吏犯贓私狀數紙，曰：「有人通此狀，恨不得推究其事。

translations.literal: At execution he held several sheets in his sleeve denouncing prefecture and county officials for embezzlement, saying: "If anyone passes on these denunciations, I would sorely regret not having pursued the cases.
translations.idiomatic: At execution he held several sheets in his sleeve denouncing prefecture and county officials for embezzlement, saying: "If anyone passes on these denunciations, I would sorely regret not having pursued the cases.

sentences.zh: 主州政者，無宜寢也。」

translations.literal: Those who govern the prefecture should not suppress them."
translations.idiomatic: Those who govern the prefecture should not suppress them."

sentences.zh: 贊曰：王德將衰，政在奸臣。

translations.literal: Commentary: When royal virtue was about to decline, power rested with treacherous ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: When royal virtue was about to decline, power rested with treacherous ministers.

sentences.zh: 鷹犬搏擊，縱之者人。

translations.literal: Hawks and hounds strike down prey—yet it is men who set them loose.
translations.idiomatic: Hawks and hounds strike down prey—yet it is men who set them loose.

sentences.zh: 遭其毒螫，可為悲辛。

translations.literal: To suffer their venomous sting—how piteous and bitter.
translations.idiomatic: To suffer their venomous sting—how piteous and bitter.

sentences.zh: 作法為害，延濫不仁。

translations.literal: Those who made the law to harm others spread cruelty without end.
translations.idiomatic: Those who made the law to harm others spread cruelty without end.
